topic.title: [Bug] Simulator switch the deck between players

messages.content:
I find in some games, the 2 players decks is switched.
For example in this game:
https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/pokemon-tcg-ai-battle/submissions?submissionId=55293612&episodeId=90393243#

I (Ruko) am using Lopunny deck and opponent is Alakazam deck. But the game showing I am using Alakazam and I lose the game, even the Lopunny deck won.
